lines: // Note (kb:adr/notes-muster-owned-session-field-whole-text): the developer's own text,
// nil = no note, never an empty or whitespace-only string. Display-only — never read by
// the state machine, the status path, rebinds, resume, reconcile or liveness. Written
// only by Manager.SetNote under Manager.mu, always replaced with a fresh pointer, never
// written through, so restoreChangedFields can compare it by identity.
keeps.reason: Without it a reader would assign through the pointer (*s.Note = text) or store an empty string at `Note *string`; that breaks the by-identity comparison in restoreChangedFields and the nil-means-no-note invariant.

lines: /** `diagramPass` is always the most recently started diagram pass — the theme observer
* chains behind it; a fresh document open simply replaces it, since a superseded pass's
* own `isCurrent` guard already keeps it from touching the new body regardless of
* ordering. Each pass (an open's `renderDiagrams` call, or a theme flip's
* `rerenderDiagrams` call) draws its own fresh id from `mintDiagramInstance` at the
* call site below — never a value fixed for this instance's lifetime. */
keeps.reason: Edited on `main`; still true: `private diagramPass: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();` is the latest pass and passes draw ids via mintDiagramInstance.

lines: // Render phase order (behaviour-bearing — see each phase's own controller for why its
// position matters):
//  1. actions  — dead-pane tracking (registered inside initActions)
//  2. usage    — gauges/model week/model readout (initUsage)
//  3. update   — Updates section + Settings badge (initUpdate)
//  4. issue    — Issue button disabled state (initIssue)
//  5. tiles    — membership: tilesLive tracks density (initTiles)
//  6. focus    — default focusedId (initFocus)
//  7. surfaces — open/close diff over (id, kind) keys (initSurfaces)
//  8. reader   — mount/dispose diff over docs-selected sessions (initReader)
//  9. rail     — the groups chrome (filter row, Select, selection bar), the sections and
//     their cards, count, sort select (initRail, which calls `groups.renderChrome` first;
//     initGroups registers no phase of its own — it is constructed before focus, which reads it)
// 10. views    — switcher, density control, view containers' hidden, then focus (view) in
//     Focus, else tiles (view) in Tiles — registered inside initViews, since that phase is
//     inherently split across two controllers by shared state (views.ts).
// 11. notes    — the note panel, after the focus phase has settled the focused session
//     and the mainhead has laid out the glyph the anchored panel sits under (initNotes)
// 12. connection — banner text/visibility, time-based as well as status-driven
//     (initConnection, registered further down once `updateRestart` exists to supply it)
keeps.reason: Edited on `main`; still true: the phase order list matches the init calls such as `initViews(app, { focus, tiles })` and `initNotes(app)`.
